name: perabot
description: Perabot 3D — Aplikasi pembuat bangunan & perabot 3D untuk Web dan Mobile

scripts.build:pages: npm run build && rm -rf docs && cp -r dist docs && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.test: mkdir -p build/test-dist && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}' > build/test-dist/package.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test-dist/tests/archWorkflow.test.js
